gates.intro: A short request becomes a short spec and goes through gates: deterministic checks, reviewers from other providers, a verifier and a fix. The system recommends; you decide.
gates.example.label: Sample request
gates.request.label: The request
gates.run.failed: I could not load the recorded run. Reload the page to try again.
gates.run.simulated: Simulated run: the local simulator plays Gemini, Claude and OpenAI, with no tokens and no cost. The rules, the Cotejo checks, the merge, the verification and the stop are the real code. The author records the real runs.
gates.run.real: Run recorded on {date} with the real providers.
gates.steps.label: Steps of the run
gates.step.failed: This step failed; the run went on with what it had.
gates.metrics.free: 0 USD: runs on the server, no model
gates.trace.title: Glass box of the step
gates.trace.none: No attempts: it is a deterministic check, no model.
gates.total: Run total: {usd} USD (COP {cop}) out of a {cap} USD cap · {steps} steps · {tokens} tokens · {seconds} s
gates.round.title: Round {n}
gates.round.draft: The draft before the free fix
gates.round.notReviewed: This round did not get reviewed.
gates.findings.title: Findings of round {n}
gates.findings.rule: Merge rule, with no hidden weights: findings are grouped by criterion and place; if both reviewers agree, it is marked “seen by both”. The gravity is the highest reported and the confidence, the highest. Every blocking finding and whatever a single reviewer reported with confidence below 0.6 go to the verifier. What falls is struck through and does not count. Whatever points to a place that does not exist is dropped and logged in the trace.
gates.finding.carried: Comes from the previous round: its place did not change and nobody marked it as resolved.
gates.verify.knocked: Knocked down by the verifier: it stays visible and does not count for the recommendation.
gates.notes.title: What the trace logged ({count})
gates.note.lugar-inexistente: {seat} pointed at {where}, which does not exist in the spec: it was dropped before being shown.
gates.note.fuera-de-cambio: {seat} pointed at {where}, which did not change in this round: it was dropped.
gates.note.revisor-caido: {seat} did not answer as a reviewer: {detail}
gates.note.sin-verificador: {detail} at {where}: there was no verifier from another provider.
gates.note.sin-veredicto: The verifier {seat} gave no verdict on {detail} ({where}).
gates.note.recortado: Texts were trimmed to the contract length.
gates.note.esquema-reintento: The spec did not meet the contract ({detail}) and the writer was asked again.
gates.note.correccion-gratis: The deterministic checks failed ({detail}): the writer fixed it once before the reviewers, without counting as a round.
gates.note.resuelto: {seat} marked {detail} ({where}) from the previous round as resolved.
gates.recommendation.title: System recommendation
gates.recommendation.note: It is a recommendation, never an approval: it comes from a server rule over the findings still standing, not from model text.
gates.stop.limpia: It stopped because no blocking or important findings remain.
gates.stop.dos-rondas: It stopped because the two automatic rounds are done.
gates.stop.empeoro: It stopped because the fix made it worse: the last round has more blocking findings than the one before.
gates.stop.tope-corrida: It stopped because the spend plus the estimate of the next step went over the run’s 0.05 USD cap.
gates.stop.sin-presupuesto: It stopped because the port reported no budget left this month: it shows what it managed to do.
gates.stop.revision-no-disponible: Review not available: there was no provider other than the writer’s, and nobody reviews their own.
gates.stop.no-es-software: The request is not a software feature: nothing was spent on review.
gates.stop.sin-tiempo: It stopped so as not to exceed the function’s maximum time: it shows what it managed to do.
gates.stop.ronda-pedida: It stopped after the round you asked for: there is only one per run.
gates.stop.redactor-caido: It stopped because the writer did not answer in the fix: the last reviewed version stays.
gates.decide.title: You decide
gates.decide.intro: The system recommends; the decision is yours and goes into revision.json.
gates.decide.comment.label: What would you change (up to {max} characters)
gates.decide.recorded: A recorded run has no new round: your comment stays in the decision. With an account and your own request, the writer would do one more round with it and the review would run again over what changed.
gates.decide.running: Running the round you asked for…
gates.live.title: Your own request, live
gates.live.intro: With an account you write your request and watch it go down the path, step by step. Each run costs 0.05 USD at most, paid by the author: you get 2 a day.
gates.live.label: Your request (up to {max} characters)
gates.live.hint: A URL is accepted as text: the server does not visit it.
gates.live.running: Running: the steps arrive as they finish.
gates.live.signinHint: Without an account you see the recorded runs, at no cost.
gates.live.local: This server has no keys: the local simulator answers, marked as such and at no cost.
gates.live.consent.title: Before sending
gates.live.consent.body: Your request goes to Google (Gemini), Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI to write and review the spec. This site stores neither it, nor the spec, nor your decision.
gates.live.error.account: You need to sign in with your account to run live.
gates.live.error.consent: You need to accept the providers notice before sending.
gates.live.error.rate_limited: You already did your 2 runs today: come back tomorrow.
gates.live.error.daily_cap: Today’s live runs are used up for everyone: come back tomorrow.
gates.live.error.budget: The monthly ceiling of the AI demos was reached: come back next month.
gates.live.error.off: The live run is not active right now.
gates.live.error.too_short: Write a bit more: at least 12 characters.
gates.live.error.failed: The run failed. Try again later.
gates.live.error.writer: The writer did not return a valid spec twice: the run ended without spending on review.
gates.live.error.stream: The connection dropped before the end; the steps that arrived stay.
gates.live.error.too_expensive: This run’s estimate goes over the 0.05 USD cap: it does not run.
gates.live.error.run_cap: There is no budget for another round in this run: you keep what you have.
gates.live.error.already: You already asked for this run’s round: it can only happen once.
gates.live.error.expired: This run is more than a day old: for another round, start a new one.
gates.live.error.invalid_run: The run did not pass the server check, so there is no new round.
gates.live.error.not_allowed: This run does not allow another round.

gates.download.revisionHint: Decide first: revision.json carries your decision.
gates.download.acta.added: It went into your note for the “From request to spec” station in the record.
gates.download.acta.hint: If you are doing the 10-minute route, the summary and your decision go into this station’s note.
gates.download.acta.none: Start the 10-minute route to add this to its record.
gates.download.acta.failed: I could not write to this browser’s record; the downloads still work.

gates.evals.title: How the review is measured
gates.evals.none: There is no eval run yet: the author runs the battery (seeded defects, clean specs, false findings and injection) with npm run evals:gates, about 0.40 USD per run.
gates.evals.latest: Latest eval run, {date}: it found {found} of {defects} seeded defects, the verifier knocked down {knocked} of {planted} false findings and there were {falseBlockers} false blocking findings across {clean} clean specs. Cost: {usd} USD.
gates.evals.injection: Alert: {failed} of {cases} injection cases got “Ready to approve” in the latest eval run.
gates.evals.injectionOk: None of the {cases} injection cases got “Ready to approve”.
gates.evals.simulated: Simulated eval run: it only tests the mechanism, not the quality of the models.
